🏷️ Fresh Graduate | Banking & Finance

🏢 Company: Dashen Bank SC  

💼 Positions:  
1. Customer Service Officer- Maker  
   📍 Location: Bahir Dar District  
   🎓 Requirements:  
   - Bachelor Degree in a business related field (e.g., Marketing Management, Accounting, Management, Economics, Business Administration, Information Technology or equivalent)  
   - CGPA 2.5 and above  
   - Zero years of experience  
   - Age not more than 25 years (for external applicants)  
   - Fresh graduates from 2025/2026 G.C only  
   - Degree certificate, Grade 8th and 12th certificates, updated CV and application letter  
   - Good command of Microsoft Office and core banking system  
   - Strong communication, analytical, and customer relationship skills  

📅 Deadline: September 10, 2026  

📝 Application Method: Apply via source job page  
🔗 Link: https://career55.sapsf.eu/sfcareer/jobreqcareer?jobId=2306&company=dashenbank
